name: SAHaRA
fullName: Liberal or Restrictive Transfusion Strategy in Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage
population: n=742, critically ill adults, NIHSS all clinical grades, critical-care period after aSAH
teachingPoint: A liberal (Hgb ≤10) transfusion threshold after aSAH did not improve 12-month outcome — restrictive transfusion remains reasonable.

name: ULTRA
fullName: Ultra-Early Tranexamic Acid After Subarachnoid Haemorrhage
population: n=955, adults, NIHSS all grades, immediately after diagnosis, until aneurysm treatment or 24 h
teachingPoint: Routine ultra-early tranexamic acid is not indicated in aSAH — prioritise early aneurysm securing instead.

name: EARLYDRAIN
fullName: Effectiveness of Lumbar Cerebrospinal Fluid Drain Among Patients With Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Hemorrhage
population: n=287, median 55 (IQR 48-63); 68.6% female, NIHSS all clinical grades, lumbar drain started within 72 h of SAH, after aneurysm securing within 48 h
teachingPoint: Prophylactic early lumbar drainage after aneurysm securing reduced secondary infarction and unfavorable 6-month outcome.
